description: .NET for iOS / .NET MAUI bindings for the Ant Media WebRTC iOS SDK, built from ant-media/WebRTC-iOS-SDK. Lets a .NET app publish and play WebRTC streams through an Ant Media Server. The upstream SDK is Swift and exposes almost nothing to Objective-C, so this package binds an @objc facade maintained alongside it — see the project site for the API surface.
title: .NET for iOS bindings for the Ant Media WebRTC iOS SDK.
